root: ^We were very sorry to hear about your daughter Orianna's condition and your spouses untimely passing. All of us at Medical Academy offer you our deep condolences.

^Unfortunately with the state of our country followed by the requirements from the army, government and other parties, our resources are extremely limited. We are unable to fund your research on the condition of your child and the state of profound unconsciousness.
^Again, we are very sorry. We believe you are capable and that you could make better progress at our laboratories. Contact us if you'd like to come back and return to your prior research.
